local_preflight: UNAVAILABLE: no usable executor; never passed
acceptance: No checklist item accepted from helper tests; combined app, UI robot, audio, replay and privacy gates unverified

items.requirement: Enable spoken turn guidance by default.
items.outcome: Settings.sound defaults ALL; source-inspected only.

items.requirement: Make lowering guidance during a phone call optional/configurable.
items.outcome: No configurable phone-call ducking preference found; unimplemented.

items.requirement: Keep all visual guidance and warnings visible while muted.
items.outcome: Driving visuals do not branch on sound; full rendered muted robot missing.

items.requirement: Tapping the instruction card repeats the current valid spoken instruction while respecting sound mode and remaining silent when fully muted.
items.outcome: Instruction-card repeat integration unverified; requires current-valid instruction and mode robot.

items.requirement: When there is no instruction to repeat, tapping the instruction card does nothing, with no sound or visual feedback.
items.outcome: No-instruction no-op has no executed UI evidence.

items.requirement: Do not show a brief confirmation label or toast when changing sound state.
items.outcome: cycleSound currently posts showMessage; B warning worker removes on separate branch.

items.requirement: Cycle the map sound control in the order Full → Alerts only → Muted → Full.
items.outcome: Actual enum order ALL/ALERTS/OFF passes baseline and after; controller cycles enum ordinal; interaction robot missing.

items.requirement: Open sound settings when the sound icon is long-pressed.
items.outcome: JourneyBar sound button has click only, no long-press sound settings action; unimplemented.

items.requirement: Label the three sound states exactly “Full”, “Alerts only” and “Muted”.
items.outcome: Actual enum baseline wrong Full/Muted labels; candidate component changes exact labels and tests.

items.requirement: Use labels alone for the three state choices, without extra descriptions beneath each label.
items.outcome: Candidate removes soundModeExplanation text beneath sound choices; source integration only, UI robot missing.

items.requirement: Highlight the whole selected sound-state button.
items.outcome: Choice fills/borders entire selected pill; source-inspected, UI robot missing.

items.requirement: Reflect changes made in sound settings on the map icon after closing settings.
items.outcome: JourneyBar reads vm.settings.sound.icon; source-inspected reactive integration, UI robot missing.

items.requirement: Return without confirmation when leaving sound settings without changes.
items.outcome: SettingsSheet dismissal has no sound-specific confirmation; source-only, UI robot missing.

items.requirement: Save sound-setting changes automatically when leaving.
items.outcome: Choice calls updateSettings immediately; durable Android persistence and dismissal tests missing.

items.requirement: Do not add an undo action for sound-state changes.
items.outcome: No sound-state undo observed; UI robot missing.

items.requirement: Update the sound icon picture instantly when it is tapped on the map.
items.outcome: Reactive vm.settings sound binding; tap-to-picture timing unverified.

items.requirement: Keep sound-state switching silent, without a switching sound effect.
items.outcome: cycleSound does not explicitly invoke audio; no device switching-audio evidence.

items.requirement: If a sentence is playing when sound mode changes, let it finish before applying the new audio state; no additional wait-time cap is required.
items.outcome: Main updateSettings immediately voice.stop on OFF violates finish-sentence; B voice owner stages pipeline fix separately.

items.requirement: Apply a sound-mode change immediately if no sentence is playing.
items.outcome: Main sound state updated immediately; actual playback gate proof delegated to B voice owner.

items.requirement: Swap sound icon pictures without animation.
items.outcome: String picture reads directly without animation; UI frame capture missing.

items.requirement: Use a speaker with waves for Full and a speaker with a red slash for Muted.
items.outcome: Full uses speaker waves emoji; Muted emoji red slash colour cannot be guaranteed across platform fonts; unresolved rendered icon requirement.

items.requirement: Use a plain speaker without waves or a slash for Alerts only.
items.outcome: Actual Alerts emoji baseline has wave; candidate uses plain speaker U+1F508, component test; rendered platform proof missing.

items.requirement: Full mode speaks all enabled guidance and warnings; Muted shows visuals only.
items.outcome: Existing Voice mode gates under B voice owner; full visual/audio integration unverified.

items.requirement: Alerts only uses tones for main alerts: cameras, speeding and immediate road dangers; exclude speed bumps and minor hazards from its tones.
items.outcome: Existing Alerts warning speech conflicts with tones preference; B voice owner.

items.requirement: Use distinct short default tones for the main alert types; tone patterns are delegated for recommendation.
items.outcome: Distinct tone playback patterns need actual audio evidence; B voice owner.

items.requirement: In Full mode, announce all enabled warnings, including minor hazards.
items.outcome: Enabled minor-warning Full-mode coverage unverified; B voice owner.

items.requirement: Provide a guidance-volume control separate from music volume.
items.outcome: No separate guidance-volume setting found; unimplemented.

items.requirement: Provide voice and speaking-speed choices in Settings.
items.outcome: Existing timing preference changes early/late not speaking speed; no voice or speaking-rate choices found; unimplemented.

items.requirement: Provide adjustable text and control sizes in Settings.
items.outcome: Accessibility page links Android settings; no in-app adjustable text/control size settings; unimplemented.

items.requirement: Choose the default text-size behaviour through the delegated recommendation.
items.outcome: Recommended default: follow Android font scaling with accessible minimum touch targets. Current source follows phone scale with driving-text caps; rendered verification missing.

items.requirement: Represent every warning on the map with a symbol.
items.outcome: Map hazard rendering exists, but every warning type symbol coverage unverified.

items.requirement: Keep map warnings symbol-only when tapped, without extra text labels.
items.outcome: Map warning tap behavior not comprehensively tested; symbol-only acceptance unverified.

items.requirement: Provide a symbol legend in Settings.
items.outcome: No symbol legend found in Settings; unimplemented.

items.requirement: Make the symbol legend available only outside navigation.
items.outcome: No legend exists; navigation exclusion unimplemented.

items.requirement: Present the legend as one simple list.
items.outcome: No legend exists; simple-list requirement unimplemented.

items.requirement: Use a fixed priority order for the legend, with speed cameras first.
items.outcome: No legend exists; fixed camera-first ordering unimplemented.

items.requirement: Keep the sound control visible and place other routine controls in the appropriate menu.
items.outcome: JourneyBar sound always in actions and other actions in menu; source-inspected, full viewport robot missing.

items.requirement: Choose measurement units automatically from location.
items.outcome: Format initialized using Locale.getDefault().country, not current location; requirement unimplemented.

items.requirement: Keep journey recording off until the user enables it.
items.outcome: JourneyEvidenceStore capture defaults off; summary history writes unconditional on main. D adds per-device false-default consent; C gates arrival history write with D flag. Combined app proof missing.

items.requirement: Allow journey-history retention to be varied and support automatic deletion after the chosen period.
items.outcome: keepDays offers 0/30/90 and startup prune + explicit setting-change deletion. No clock-driven background deletion proof; partial.

items.requirement: Support backups to a personal account.
items.outcome: AccountBackupSession and DriveAppDataBackup account-scoped backup source exists; authenticated account execution unavailable; not verified.

items.requirement: Offer backup retention of one week, one month, one year, a custom period, or keep until deleted.
items.outcome: No backup-retention choices found; one-week/month/year/custom/keep-until-deleted unimplemented.

items.requirement: Delete timed backups automatically when their chosen retention period ends.
items.outcome: No scheduled authenticated cloud expiry/deletion mechanism found; unimplemented.

items.requirement: Send problem reports automatically without asking the user to review or confirm each report.
items.outcome: DiagnosticReportStore explicitly local, never queued; CrashReporter manual share. Automatic destination/transport not configured; unimplemented.
